# Steam Chase — Complete File Inventory

**Snapshot: 27 September 2026.** Start with the [project guide](PROJECT_FILE_GUIDE.md) for readable explanations, gameplay relationships, and a suggested reading order.

This inventory records **every one of the 49,601 files found on disk during the scan**, including hidden and ignored files. It includes Assets, packages, settings, tests, caches, local IDE files, and Git internals. The two Markdown documents were created after that scan and are listed separately below. Files generated or removed by Unity afterward may differ.

Use your editor's Find command to search a filename or path. The file lists use complete project-relative paths and are grouped into expandable sections. Each section explains the files' shared role and relationship to the project. For individual authored files, the main guide provides the detailed descriptions.

## Contents

- [Coverage and reading limits](#coverage-and-reading-limits)
- [Verified asset relationships](#verified-asset-relationships)

## Coverage and reading limits

| Area | Files | Role / relationship |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `(root files)` | 7 | Git/IDE configuration and generated C# solution/project files. The main guide describes each one. |
| `Assets` | 247 | Game code, scenes, prefab, art, settings, imported plugins, fonts/shaders, and their metadata. |
| `Packages` | 2 | Manifest and lockfile controlling Unity dependency resolution. |
| `ProjectSettings` | 26 | Shared editor, engine, rendering, input, and build configuration. |
| `Tests` | 2 | Standalone checks targeting older combat sources that are absent. |
| `UserSettings` | 4 | Local Unity editor layout, search, and preference data. |
| `Library` | 48,358 | Unity-imported assets, cached packages, compiled assemblies, build products, and editor state. |
| `Temp` | 6 | Transient Unity session/build files. |
| `obj` | 4 | Intermediate IDE/compiler work products. |
| `Logs` | 12 | Diagnostic records produced by editor/package/import/build processes. |
| `.vs` | 20 | Local Visual Studio caches and workspace state. |
| `.git` | 913 | Version-control database and repository bookkeeping; names inventoried, contents not audited. |

**Inspection depth:** all current gameplay scripts and the older tests were read; project assets/configuration and metadata were examined for serialized relationships. Package internals, DLLs, images, fonts, Git objects, and opaque caches are indexed by path and subsystem, not exhaustively analyzed or decompiled. A cache filename alone does not establish a specific source-file dependency. No gameplay tests or Play Mode session were run for this documentation.

**Metadata rule:** each `.meta` path identifies the file or folder at the same path with the final `.meta` removed. Assets contains 102 file companions and 43 folder metadata files. Those metadata files supply GUIDs; importer settings also control textures, scripts, DLLs, and other assets.

**Added documentation:** [PROJECT_FILE_GUIDE.md](<PROJECT_FILE_GUIDE.md>) explains the project; [PROJECT_FILE_INVENTORY.md](<PROJECT_FILE_INVENTORY.md>) is this index. These two files are outside the scan counts.
